query.title: Keyword search
query.description: Keyword(s) to search for, e.g. a case name, party, or legal topic.

resultType.title: Search type
resultType.description: Search case opinions, or RECAP federal case dockets/filings.

court.title: Court filter (optional)
court.description: CourtListener court ID, e.g. "scotus" (Supreme Court), "ca9" (9th Circuit). Leave blank for all courts.

filedAfter.title: Filed after (optional)
filedAfter.description: Only include results filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

filedBefore.title: Filed before (optional)
filedBefore.description: Only include results filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return for this search.

apiToken.title: CourtListener API token (optional)
apiToken.description: Optional. CourtListener works anonymously at low volume; supplying your own free CourtListener API token raises the rate limit. Get one at courtlistener.com/profile/api-token/.
